summary_en: FY2026/6 year-end dividend raised to ¥16/share from ¥15/share (prior forecast). Interim dividend ¥32/share confirmed. Full-year total not disclosed due to 2:1 stock split on 1 Jan 2026. Cumulative and performance-linked dividend policy maintained.
title_en: Notice of dividend forecast revision (dividend increase) for FY2026/6
translation_en_brief: System Support Holdings announced on 3 August 2026 a revision to its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending 30 June 2026. The year-end dividend per ordinary share has been raised to ¥16 from the prior forecast of ¥15 per share, representing a ¥1 per share increase. The interim dividend at the second quarter end (record date 31 December 2025) remains ¥32 per share. The company notes that the prior forecast for the interim dividend was issued on 4 February 2026. A full-year dividend total is not disclosed because the company executed a 2-for-1 stock split effective 1 January 2026, making simple calculation impractical; the interim dividend figure stated reflects the pre-split share count. The company's dividend policy is progressive and linked to earnings performance and profit levels. The revision reflects both this policy and the company's FY2026/6 business performance. The dividend is subject to approval at the 47th annual shareholder meeting scheduled for September 2026.
